prompt:
Create ONE native editable SVG sheet: FOUR genuine diagonal quarters of the SAME Furnace brute, exact monster ID demon, for Emberwake dark-fantasy action RPG. It is a PHYSICAL MELEE enemy, NOT a fire caster or boss. Bold sculptural painted/cut-paper fantasy with curved connected anatomy, three broad value groups and strong native32-40px readability. No photoreal PBR, plastic gloss, random noisy texture or flat token figures.

CHARACTER: a heavy rust-red living biped with broad load-bearing shoulders, thick continuous neck, low forward-thrust skull, deep solid chest, thick abdomen connected into hips, powerful unequal planted legs and broad unarmored feet. One shoulder leads while the other carries the weapon weight. Bent knees and compressed forward stance, not upright trophy pose. Long arms connect through believable elbows/wrists into heavy hands. It must read as substantial muscle and weight, not a rounded toy or disconnected polygon parts. A plain dark leather waist wrap/loincloth is functional and quiet; no plate armor. Head small relative to shoulder mass, recessed dark eyes beneath brow, angular jaw, small closed teeth. Unequal IVORY horns grow from skull: anatomical LEFT horn is long, sweeping back/out, anatomical RIGHT horn short with broken tip. Preserve that individual asymmetry across all headings. Anatomical RIGHT hand carries ONE plain heavy FORGED CLEAVER near the hip/knee; short dark grip and a broad blunt-backed rectangular/trapezoid steel blade, simple honest cutting edge, not an axe/staff/halberd or magical artifact. Anatomical LEFT hand is a low clenched fist or brace. Cleaver is heavy, never floating or passing through the body. One quiet diagonal chest scar may appear only when front chest visible. NO glowing furnace chest, embers, fire breath, flames, smoke, molten cracks, magical eyes, halo, spell trails or external VFX.

PALETTE: native game rust-red #c16a4d, warm body middle #b96a4f, lit skin #df9270, red shadow #743e36, deep form #3b2b2a, ivory horn #dbc99f with pale tip #eee0bb, dark leather #4a3630, forged steel #78817c and a restrained edge #b9c0ae. Common light from SCREEN upper-left in EVERY view. Planes receiving upper-left light stay light even when heading reverses; do not mirror lighting with geometry. Form first, quiet surfaces, sparse decisive cuts following muscle/cloth/metal. No ornament pile, repetitive ribs/scales or yellow edge trim everywhere.

SHEET: exact viewBox="0 0 1536 832", width1536 height832. TWO columns x TWO rows, sheet cell768x416. One centered384x416 sprite workspace in each cell. Four top-level local-coordinate groups ONLY: id="demon-se" transform="translate(192 0)", id="demon-sw" transform="translate(960 0)", id="demon-ne" transform="translate(192 416)", id="demon-nw" transform="translate(960 416)". Group paths use LOCAL x0..384,y0..416. Keep complete figure within x35..349,y20..395. Transparent margins, no cross-cell paint. All unused space TRANSPARENT; no background, ground, terrain, base, diamond tile, cast/contact shadow, frames, arrows, labels, visible text, watermark, raster image/use elements, scripts, external resources or paint-resource IDs/gradients. Explicit fill colors. Each group must extract independently to a complete static SVG; four named groups, no extra characters.

NATIVE SCALE: all views actual visible height365-373px (horn tip through feet), width280-310px INCLUDING cleaver and horns. At0.1 source scale this is approximately30x37px, matching intended field footprint. Do not solve structure by enlarging the figure beyond that footprint. All four share head/body/weapon proportions and a ground contact near localy390. The taller sprite workspace is headroom only: world tiles remain square and screen-aligned, NOT a diamond-isometric floor. Fixed mild elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC camera looking down27degrees. Show a little top shoulder/skull/foot plane. No ground is drawn.

FOUR REAL QUARTERS: physically rotate one coherent character about its vertical axis with fixed camera. Opposing SE/SW front quarters, NE/NW rear quarters. Head direction, horn roots, near/far shoulders, side chest plane, belt wrap, thigh overlap, feet and cleaver grip rotate TOGETHER. No near-duplicate fronts or near-duplicate backs; turning only the face is insufficient. No whole-character mirroring: redraw overlap, gear occlusion and upper-left screen lighting. Keep left-long/right-broken horns and right-hand cleaver attached to anatomical sides. Hide far anatomy honestly. Rear views show back/shoulder blades and back of skull, no chest scar/face painted on the back.

SE top-left: faces lower RIGHT, heavy front-quarter. Nose/jaw and near foot project lower-right, a broad front chest and narrower right-facing side plane are visible. Near shoulder overlaps far upper arm; near knee compresses under load, far boot higher/behind. Right-hand cleaver stays low beside hip/knee, weighted forearm/handle visibly connected. Left fist answers the forward lean. Long left horn and short right horn remain visibly unequal.

SW top-right: faces lower LEFT, true opposite front quarter. Head and foremost foot point left, shoulder depths and chest/side plane widths visibly change; opposing arm/hip overlaps and boot support differ from SE. Same individual asymmetry and right-hand cleaver, with changed occlusion. Same screen upper-left light; do not flip all highlight planes or merely shift a face inside the same frontal torso.

NE bottom-left: faces upper RIGHT, genuine rear-quarter. Broad upper back, near shoulder blade, narrow turned torso-side plane and rump/thigh load dominate. Back of skull and horn roots visible; muzzle only peeks beyond far shoulder if anatomically visible, NO frontal face through head. Near heel is lower/broader, far foot foreshortened and points upper-right. Right-hand cleaver appears around the turn or is partly occluded by hip; never switches hand. Keep connected neck/back/waist/hips.

NW bottom-right: faces upper LEFT, opposite rear yaw. Back contour, shoulder depths, neck/horn overlap, cleaver occlusion and foot direction differ clearly from NE. Keep left-long/right-broken horns, right-hand weapon and same proportions, with honest upper-left lighting.

CRITICAL CONSTRUCTION CHECK: draw a SOLID connected neck/chest/abdomen/hip silhouette BEFORE adding limbs, belts or accents. There must be actual painted body below shoulders and above waist: NO transparent torso/waist gaps, detached mantle, floating head/arms, absent lower legs or arbitrary disconnected dark patches. Chest/back volume must bridge visibly into the hips and support the head/arms. Start with weight and anatomy, then three light planes, then weapon/material accents. Four coherent quarter views and30x37px identity matter more than tiny surface marks. Static directional study, no animation or extra frames.
